notes.title: A simple review from you can change the future of Grandma Badass!
notes.notes:
[h1]Have you played Grandma Badass and liked the game? Did you have a good time?[/h1]

Please know that you can make one last gesture of kindness and kindness towards this game before the end of the year: all you have to do is give your opinion on the game!
Many people are unaware of the importance of his review on the game’s Steam page, small and short as it is!

When you post a positive comment or review about the game on the page, it allows it to be more highlighted on the platform. [b]Below 50 reviews[/b] from players who have purchased the game (the games offered are not counted)…the game remains invisible.

[b]A positive review posted sometimes even takes less than a minute…[/b]and pushes the game up in the Steam algorithm to make it more visible.
The chain reaction is no longer long in coming: motivation and recognition…we want to play another game…
But if people love the game, but don’t say it…well the game remains in the depths of the abyss of Steam…no longer sells…and no longer gives the motivation to make new other games.

So understand that leaving your opinion on the game’s Steam page is of capital importance, especially when you are like me a solo developer, who does everything from A to Z on your own…

[b]I need your support and it doesn’t take more than a minute[/b]…so if you bought the Grandma Badass game, played it and enjoyed it (even if you didn’t still had time to finish it), so please leave a review on its Steam page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1606640/GrandMa_Badass__a_crazy_point_and_click_adventure/#app_reviews_hash]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1606640/GrandMa_Badass__a_crazy_point_and_click_adventure/#app_reviews_hash[/url]

notes.title: Vote for Grandma to win this title!
notes.notes:
[h1]GRANDMA BADASS POINT AND CLICK[/h1]

It's a fact: Grandma Badass has never really been highlighted anywhere except on a few social media platforms of gamers who had the chance to discover it through word of mouth.

The game, developed solo with no budget, couldn't stand out, fitting into a micro-niche of point-and-click games that isn't particularly sought after in the gaming universe.

But that doesn't stop the game [b]from receiving nothing but positive reviews on blogs and a 100% positive rating from curators and players![/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1606640/GrandMa_Badass__a_crazy_point_and_click_adventure/#app_reviews_hash]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1606640/GrandMa_Badass__a_crazy_point_and_click_adventure/#app_reviews_hash[/url]

It lacks a little recognition, which can only come from the few players who have launched the game and loved it... YOU!

Thank you in advance for promoting the game on your social media or on your Steam account to give it a chance not to fade into obscurity.

notes.title: Grandma Badass has 100% positive player votes!
notes.notes:
[h1]Grandma Badass has received 100% positive votes from players[/h1]

[h2]It's a big milestone! [/h2]
Grandma Badass has just passed the [b]100% positive player review[/b] mark and thanks everyone who bought the game and was kind enough to leave a positive review on Steam.

It's very important to do this and many players don't necessarily have the habit or reflex of leaving a review once the game is finished.
However, this allows the developers to get feedback on the game, and Steam to find out that it is invoking some success with its members.

So, this milestone of passing 10 positive reviews is vital for a game to be a little more visible in the shop and so I thank once again all those who have shared their impressions on the Steam page of the game Grandma Badass!

notes.title: Play Grandma Badass on your Steam Deck!
notes.notes:
[h1]You can play GrandMa Badass on your Steam Deck[/h1]
[h2]The Grandma Badass game is compatible with your Steam Deck handheld![/h2]

However, this is a [b]point and click game,[/b] set up essentially in the pure tradition of PC screen gaming with mouse and keyboard.
But you can still use your fingers to click and play without constraint.

Moreover, a [b]direct save[/b] button allows you to save your game at any time and restart it whenever you want.

[b]To set up your Steam Deck buttons[/b] to match the mouse buttons, however, you'll need to make a small adjustment on your console.

[h3]But nothing too complicated if you follow the guide provided by the REDD player at:[/h3]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2890986713]https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2890986713[/url]

notes.title: News about the development of GrandMa Badass
notes.notes:
[h1]What's next for GrandMa Badass?[/h1]

[b]The point at September 3, 2022[/b]

Knowing that many of you have already played GrandMa Badass episode 1 and 2 when these 2 opuses were offered for sale individually, you will then be interested to find out a little more about what's in store for you and what stage the development of this point and click is at.

[h2]What will happen first when GrandMa Badass is released?[/h2]
If you're a lucky purchaser of Episode 1, who trusted the project when it was released and didn't delete it, then you'll simply be thanked by automatically getting an update to the FULL game, over Episode 1.

[This means that for the price of one episode, you will get the full game. [/b](which should be sold 19.99 €)

[h2]Where is the project at this time, early September?[/h2]
The game follows its development course and as of September 3, is therefore at the stage of the end of design of episode 4.
As a reminder, there are 5 episodes planned.

[h2]Do we have an idea of the release date of the complete game?[/h2]
The release date is estimated for the end of the last quarter of 2022.
Due to the very large number of releases in November, it is likely that the game will be released for December 2022.
But also, depending on the status, maybe earlier, for October. Today, nothing is certain yet, the priority being to offer you a complete game, which makes you go through all the states of mind and will captivate you at least 8 hours...

[h2]Any news about the game since the release of episode 2?[/h2]
You will have to start the game from scratch because the whole system has changed and the saves will not be operational anymore.

-A new gameplay with the optional display of the preference bar and the inventory during the game. (the game in 16/9 will display the GUI inventory and preference only when you move the mouse pointer to the top or bottom of the screen)

-A playful help system with the display of important objects with a simple press of the "Space" key

-New screens for functionalities (saving, loading, configuration etc)

-A sound mixer to manage each sound channel (sound effects, music, ambient sounds etc.)

-More Steam hits to discover, including some very rare ones.

Thanks to you and don't forget to add GrandMa Badass to your wishlist so you don't miss its release if you don't have episode 1 (released in May 2021) in your Steam library yet!

[h2]The game is all set for this big day and it has improved a lot in the space of a few days ... and all thanks to this friendly community of players on Steam![/h2]

What was supposed to be a final version, filed online 15 days ago, has turned into a real beta game.
It was not expected, but many players had fun in the game, and small minor bugs were also reported which were therefore gradually fixed in the game to provide even more enjoyable gameplay.

Better yet, the game can now enjoy [b] a perfect functioning of Steam Achievement [/ b] thanks to this community and more particularly to players that I will come back to below.
I've never been told enough: [i]"gamers love Steam Achievements"[/i] ...

So I want to thank all the players who have received a key for GrandMa Badass, who have played and given me feedback on their gaming experience, bug feedback, and in fact provided invaluable and incredible help for it. do what it is now, on May 4, 2021, the day before its release ...

[h3]I only discovered this community of players a few days ago. And they were so benevolent that I cannot conclude this little message by quoting a few of them and I apologize if I forgot any in the process, there were so many of you !!![/h3]

notes.title: Translation setup
notes.notes:
This French game is translated into several languages.
This game is configured [b]by default to be launched in French[/b] but from the launch of GrandMa Badass (grandmabadass****.exe) you can [u]select your language via the small flags to play in your language[/u].

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40370032/bfdfe72737e5f516f5baadc8c9f42f7042b44253.jpg[/img]

If you ever have translation issues, simply run the [b]winsetup.exe[/b] file by choosing your language from the drop-down menu and then clicking "Save and Run".

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40370032/42f6be1c19f0ca95206d9a950eaf4f3b39c12424.png[/img]
